worked_example.note: On the two scoreable rows G1 and G2 (10:00-style cut): G1 |est-act|=2 min and |sched-act|=10 min; G2 has its ETA cleared so only sched is available, |sched-act|=20 min. Scheduled coverage N=2, estimated coverage N=1, paired N=1. On the single paired sample the paired absolute-error difference (est minus sched) = 2-10 = -8 min = -480_000_000 us.  Subtracting the two one-sided MEAN absolute errors instead would compare different populations: 2 - ((10+20)/2) = -13 min (-780_000_000 us), which is why the paired difference is the only valid comparison.
